criteria.description: Both `stats` and `stats2` execute successfully on PostgreSQL 17 and SQLite, retaining their GraphQL response shapes and daily/week selection behavior.
criteria.evidence: statistics/summary_test.go shared suite (WP03) passes on SQLite + PostgreSQL; dashboard/postgres_acceptance_test.go TestStatsGraphQLShapes_* asserts both stats/stats2 RangedStatisticsEntries shape on both engines (WP04).
criteria.notes: Verified by WP03 and WP04 review: identical fixtures pass on SQLite and disposable PostgreSQL (incl. session-TZ).

criteria.description: Duration is clipped to each requested range and rounded per span to whole seconds before summation, preserving current local user-time semantics; running spans excluded; boundaries characterized.
criteria.evidence: statistics/summary_test.go boundary fixtures (equal/reversed ranges, empty keys, active spans, fractional 0.4s->0/0.8s->1) and TestStats_postgres_sessionTimeZone (WP03); statistics/summary2_test.go daily + midnight-crossing fixtures (WP04).
criteria.notes: Verified: per-span rounding both dialects; session-TimeZone independence proven (timestamptz bounds); running spans excluded.

criteria.description: Include OR, Exclude OR, exclusion precedence, tag grouping, zero fill, and user isolation preserved; correct aliases/joins do not change semantics.
criteria.evidence: statistics/summary_test.go fixtures for multiple tags, duplicate filter matches, exclusion precedence, user isolation (WP03); statistics/summary2_test.go Include/Exclude + zero-fill daily scenarios (WP04).
criteria.notes: Verified on both engines with fixed expected seconds.

criteria.description: SQL execution and scan failures return resolver errors rather than successful empty/zero statistics.
criteria.evidence: statistics/summary_test.go TestStats_errorPropagation (WP03) checks .Error on Raw().Scan() before zero-fill; forced execution failure returns non-nil error.
criteria.notes: Verified: query error propagates to resolver, no fabricated empty result.

criteria.description: DashboardType, Interval, DeviceType load database string and byte-slice values and persist consistently across supported PostgreSQL schemas and SQLite; unsupported types produce a defined error; nil handling established.
criteria.evidence: model/dashboard_test.go + model/device_test.go (WP02) cover string + []byte Scan, nil error, unsupported-type error, round-trip; dashboard/postgres_persistence_test.go + device/postgres_persistence_test.go exercise text + legacy bytea columns via lib/pq.
criteria.notes: Verified: scanStringEnum accepts string and []byte; bytea path genuinely exercised on real columns.

criteria.description: Dashboard/device operations persist after reconnect/restart; no destructive or automatic text/bytea conversion required for initial compatibility.
criteria.evidence: dashboard/postgres_persistence_test.go + device/postgres_persistence_test.go lifecycle/reconnect tests on file-backed SQLite and PostgreSQL; TestStartupMigration_reopen_textAndBytea reopens both schema variants via database.New and asserts column types retained (WP02).
criteria.notes: Verified: values survive close/reopen; AutoMigrate does not convert bytea; model.All() FK ordering fixed for fresh-PG startup.

criteria.description: The same regression fixtures run on actual PostgreSQL 17 and SQLite in CI; PostgreSQL failures or missing configuration must fail its dedicated CI job.
criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/build.yml postgres-test job (postgres:17 service, trust auth for pinned lib/pq, TRAGGO_TEST_POSTGRES_REQUIRED=1) + Makefile test-postgres target + hack/test-databases.sh (WP05); WP01 shared fixtures.
criteria.notes: Verified: required-mode rejects invalid/bad DSN (exit 1); local pipeline runs SQLite+PG; remote GitHub Actions run remains a CI follow-up.

criteria.description: Document build, immutable image identification, staging validation, Kubernetes rollout, observation, and rollback. Updating the external manifest is a later execution step in its owning repository.
criteria.evidence: docs/postgres-dashboard-rollout.md (WP06) covers T021-T024: config, immutable image procedure (baseline reconciliation, build tooling, source commit + digest, rollback), external manifest change follow-up, operational acceptance + rollback checklist. README.md PostgreSQL support section.
criteria.notes: Verified: runbook accurate, no invented facts (external repo/digest recorded as follow-ups), does not claim deployment.
